step1.title: Find a Game
step1.desc: Browse upcoming futsal sessions near you. Filter by area, format, and price.

step2.title: Top Up & Join
step2.desc: Add funds to your Bolahh wallet and book your slot in one tap. No payment hassle every time.

step3.title: Play & Get Rated
step3.desc: After the match, the organiser rates your stats. Your OVR updates and pushes you up the rank ladder.

ranks.label: PROGRESSION
ranks.title: THE RANK SYSTEM
ranks.desc: Get rated after every game. Your stats build your OVR and determine which of the 10 tiers you sit in.
ranks.everyRank: EVERY RANK HAS ITS OWN CARD

card.label: YOUR IDENTITY
card.title: YOUR BOLAHH PLAYER CARD
card.desc: Every player gets a card that reflects their rank tier. Your 6 stats, PAC, SHO, PAS, DRI, DEF and PHY are rated by our trusted manager after each game and build your OVR.
card.feat1: Card theme upgrades with your rank from Novis to Emas
card.feat2: Get card based on your true potential
card.feat3: OVR updates after every rated game
card.feat4: Friends can view your card on your profile

booking.title: Smart Booking
booking.desc: Browse, filter and join games in seconds. Real-time slot tracking.

wallet.title: Bolahh Wallet
wallet.desc: Top up once, play anytime. Instant refunds to your wallet if a game is cancelled.

rank.title: 10-Tier Rank
